row.title: Hand over a matter
row.subtitle: Test version: the assistant emails for you, only within what you confirm.

intro: Tell me the matter in your own words: whom to contact and their email address, what to ask for, whether to set up a meeting and until when. I read it back to you, and nothing is sent until you confirm.

request.label: Your matter
request.placeholder: Contact Carlos at carlos@example.com, ask for the updated proposal, set up a meeting to discuss it and follow up until Friday. Keep me copied.

result.sent: Sent. Replies to this matter are kept with it.
result.notSent: The email could not be sent yet. Try again in a moment.
result.cancelled: Matter cancelled. Nothing more will be sent.

errors.stale: The draft changed. Check it again before confirming.
errors.notAllowed: This is outside what you confirmed, so nothing was sent.
errors.unavailable: The assistant is not available for your account yet.
